fields.message: Found 1 cooperative matrix configurations supported by wgpu

Vertex shader with entry point vs_main outputs a @builtin(position) without the @invariant attribute and is used in a pipeline with Equal. On some machines, this can cause bad artifacting as Equal assumes the values output from the vertex shader exactly match the value in the depth buffer. The @invariant attribute on the @builtin(position) vertex output ensures that the exact same pixel depths are used every render.
Detected a linear (sRGBA aware) framebuffer Bgra8UnormSrgb. egui prefers Rgba8Unorm or Bgra8Unorm
